name: DisasterReady Free Disaster Response Simulation
description: This benchmark evaluates an AI agent's humanitarian response capabilities in realistic emergency scenarios. It focuses on applying the cluster system approach, rapid needs assessment, priority setting, gap analysis, and coordinated multi-sector response under complex emergency constraints.
reputation: Highly regarded free training platform used by humanitarian professionals worldwide, powered by Cornerstone OnDemand Foundation
notes: Scenario-based interactive course; strong emphasis on real-world humanitarian coordination; ideal for testing agentic multi-step planning
